name: flota
description: Gestión de flota: back Django + DRF y dos fronts (gestión VPN / conductores internet). Basado en @gs/base.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build --workspace front-gestion && npm run build --workspace front-conductores
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace front-gestion && npm run typecheck --workspace front-conductores
scripts.dev:gestion: npm run build:ui && npm run dev --workspace front-gestion
scripts.dev:conductores: npm run build:ui && npm run dev --workspace front-conductores
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace front-gestion && npm run test --workspace front-conductores
